result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): The two answers use almost the same approach: a 'Most popular' badge, an accent border, a filled button and a slight lift for Studio, with quieter outlined buttons on Starter and Network. A is tighter. Its prices clearly lead each card, the feature lists have neat dividers, and the whole section fits in the frame. B's larger heading competes a little more with the cards, and the bottom of its cards is cropped at this viewport. B's low-contrast outlined buttons on the dark background also make the secondary plans slightly less usable. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both use the same pattern for Studio: a 'Most popular' pill, a coloured border, a filled button and a slight lift. In both, the side cards are quieter but still have usable outlined buttons. B edges ahead because the divider rules make its feature lists easier to scan, and its tighter layout fits fully in view. A has big gaps between the descriptions and prices, its Starter and Network cards are cut off at the bottom of the screenshot, and its dark-on-dark side buttons are a bit low in contrast. In both answers, every price is the same size and the large heading slightly competes with the Studio card.
